evals.prompt: Evaluate a changed skill in this repository. Keep the durable spec with the skill and keep generated runs local to the repository.
evals.expected_output: Keep evals/evals.json with the skill. Store generated runs under .agents/eval-workspaces/<skill-name>/ with with_skill and old_skill configurations.
assertions: Keeps evals/evals.json as the durable skill specification.
Stores generated runs under the repository .agents/eval-workspaces directory.
Uses with_skill and old_skill configuration directories.

evals.prompt: Create a deterministic evaluation for a changed agent skill.
evals.expected_output: Use the skill_name and evals specification keys, stable case IDs, and the required manifest, benchmark, feedback, grading, and timing reports.
assertions: Uses the canonical skill_name and evals top-level keys.
Reuses stable case IDs in workspace paths and manifests.
Creates the required iteration and per-configuration report files.

evals.prompt: Before submitting a skill evaluation change, validate its files and workspace.
evals.expected_output: Run mise run ai:skills:evals:validate, ai:skills:validate-conflicts, and mise:tasks:validate-conflicts before the skill-index and repository checks.
assertions: Names the separate ai:skills:validate-conflicts and mise:tasks:validate-conflicts tasks.
Validates the skill index and repository checks after the evaluation validator.
Treats invalid JSON, misplaced workspaces, missing reports, and symlinks as validation errors.
